label: Discharge Summary Record
holds: The discharge summary for the ABDM health data set

label: Health Document Record
holds: Unstructured historical records, usually uploaded by patients through a health locker

label: Immunization Record
holds: Immunisations, vaccine certificates and next dose recommendations

label: OP Consult Record
holds: Outpatient notes: examinations, procedures, medications and clinical advice

label: Prescription Record
holds: Medication advice, following Pharmacy Council of India guidelines

label: Wellness Record
holds: Vitals, physical examination and general health data, often captured in a PHR app

label: Invoice Record
holds: Pharmacy invoices, consultation invoices and other billing
